title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - ObservationCollectionExecution
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/ObservationCollectionExecution. Execution consisting in collecting observations made by Device (e.g. Sensor, Wearable, ECG Device...) (ttl rdfs:comment). subClassOf saref:ProcedureExecution. Note: ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.3.2's worked ECG example additionally uses a closely related but differently-named s4ehaw:ObservationCollectionSession (not declared as a separate class in the published ttl) for a single recording session instance -- treated here as the same concept / a session instance of this class.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ObservationCollectionExecution'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

madeBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/madeBy'. Links to the person (HealthActor) or the Device (HealthDevice) that made the observation collection execution -- polymorphic, whichever made the observation. Reused SAREF core property; ttl's own rdfs:comment explicitly instructs 'Use saref:madeBy to link to the person or the Device that made it.'

observes.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/observes'. Links to the Patient being observed. Reused SAREF core property; ttl comment: 'Use saref:observes to link to the patient.'

hasResult.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasResult'. Links to the result, an external/unmodeled 'ObservationCollection' concept outside this candidate's class scope. Reused SAREF core property; ttl comment: 'Use saref:hasResult to link to the result, an ObservationCollection.'

hasPrecondition.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasPrecondition'. Links a command or operation to the conditions that are imposed over its inputs to be successfully invoked. Given as free text here, or as a Relationship URI if pointing to a described precondition resource. ttl-confirmed, domain is a union including saref:ProcedureExecution (ObservationCollectionExecution's own declared superclass).

hasEffect.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/hasEffect'. Links a command or operation to the effect of invoking it. Can be an alert, nothing, an activation of another process... Given as free text here, or as a Relationship URI. ttl-confirmed, same domain-union reasoning as hasPrecondition.
